title: Superadditivity of liminf in [0, ∞]
statement: For every type ι (in Lean's universe Type), every filter F on ι and all functions u, v : ι → [0, ∞] (ℝ≥0∞), liminf_F u + liminf_F v ≤ liminf_F (i ↦ u(i) + v(i)), where liminf is Mathlib's Filter.liminf in the complete lattice ℝ≥0∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) (F : Filter ι) (u v : ι → ℝ≥0∞), liminf u F + liminf v F ≤ liminf (fun i => u i + v i) F
